answer: Escrow plus a referral graph stops bulk fakes. A new identity posts a 40-unit deposit, joins a referral chain, and wears a pigment stamp, leaving no haven. Anyone may dispute a suspect for 10 epochs; a falcon audit checks its work, a fake loses its deposit to the challenger, and the graph flags its cluster. Forging 100 fakes costs 4,000 for a 30-unit reward, a 133-epoch payback. Honest agents pay 40 once, keep full rewards, and earn bounties.
